title: Quietly Resinous Egyptian Lamb Stew
description: A rich and flavorful one-pot Egyptian dish featuring mixed spice and yakimono-grill lamb, perfect for a comforting dinner. This stew is egg-free and friendly to various dietary needs.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the mixed spice, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the yakimono-grill sauce and chicken broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice or couscous.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
